evidence.detail: normalized_analyzer strips [\s/,_'-] but not double-quote; card '"Name Sticker" Goblin' indexes as '"namesticker"goblin' while search 'Name Sticker Goblin' normalizes to 'namestickergoblin' — edit distance 4 exceeds DIST=2
DIST = 2; fuzzy matching won't bridge the 4-character gap caused by the two unstripped ASCII quote chars
Added repair_name mapping in price_grabber/parser.py for Cardhoarder name→official name; fixes price storage but does not fix whoosh search
repair_name maps 'Name Sticker Goblin' → '"Name Sticker" Goblin'; price side is already handled

triage.fix_sketch: In magic/whoosh_constants.py line 9, change SubstitutionFilter pattern from r'[\s/,_\'-]' to r'[\s/,_\'"\u201c\u201d-]' (adding ASCII double-quote and curly quotes) so that card names like '"Name Sticker" Goblin', 'Kongming, "Sleeping Dragon"', and 'Pang Tong, "Young Phoenix"' index without their quote characters. Also add a whoosh_search_test entry to prevent regression.
triage.notes: Kongming and Pang Tong have the same class of name; the fix covers all cards with ASCII double-quotes in their names. The price storage path was already fixed in commit 2328d703 and does not need changes.
